# Survey components, grid and theming since 13.1 for the 13.2 notes

## Context

This is a survey leaf of #14800. It follows the [survey method](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/14800#issuecomment-5792321883) (@tobiu, 2026-09-23: the window is roughly 1,500 PRs and the split moved the Brain and the Fleet Manager out of scope).

This leaf covers **components, grid and theming**: 187 merged PRs, listed in the first comment. It holds PRs scoped `grid`, `form`, `component`, `tab`, `menu`, `draggable`, `theme`, … and, for PRs whose title names no scope, those touching the other `src/*` folders or `resources/scss/`.

## The Problem

Components and themes are what a user sees first. Grid cell editing already has a chapter (#18762, deposited 2026-09-19). The rest of the slice is unread, and the notes cannot yet tell a reader which components changed, gained features, or look different.

## The Architectural Reality

The population rule and the Tier 1–3 rubric are in the method comment.

## The Fix

Read the slice, then fold its reader-relevant items into `resources/content/release-notes/v13.2.0.md` as reader prose, inside the structure #19120 set. Cell editing keeps its chapter and is not repeated. The survey itself (counts, exclusions, nominations) stays out of the public notes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 Every PR in the slice is read. The counts (read, listed, excluded, with reasons) are posted as a comment on this ticket, and the notes carry no counts line. *(Re-pointed 2026-09-24: the items ship in #19121, vehicle B, so no PR of this ticket carries a body.)*
- [ ] AC-2 Each Tier 1–3 item reaches the notes as reader prose, through #19120 → PR #19121: what a reader can now do or must now know, with its PR or ticket. The notes carry no survey ledger.
- [ ] AC-3 At most two chapter nominations, each with evidence and its mining state, posted on #14800 rather than in the notes.
- [ ] AC-4 Reviewed cross-family.

> **Updated 2026-09-23:** after the operator's register ruling on the merged notes (#19120), the counts and nominations move out of the public notes.

## Out of Scope

- Tier-2 items beyond noting them: the upgrade-path leaf owns them.
- Dock Layouts, which has its own leaf.

## Related

#14800 · PR #19091 · #18762
